title: School at Fisk and McDonogh 24
summary: He attended school at Franklin and Perdido and McDonogh 24 through the fifth grade, then went to work.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, uh, when you went to school, did they teach music there? No.
They teach us their music there. What school did you go to? I went to Fisk and MacDonald 24. Where is Fisk? It was at the corner of Franklin and Perdita. Was that Ms. Martin's place?

This fellow, Henry Martin, that I was telling you about, that was his mother's place. Oh, I see. She was taking care of it there. And I went to that school and when we moved up from Calton, I went to MacDonald number 24. I went as far to fifth grade. I played hookah so the old lady pulled me out and I went to Roy. I've been working ever since.
